payload.core_mechanism_summary: For every empty cell, check four directions (horizontal, vertical, two diagonals) by extending in both sides while encountering 'X'. If any direction yields total consecutive X's (including placed) >=5, return YES.
payload.rationale: The solution performs a brute-force check over all empty cells, examining lines in all directions. This fits complete search (exhaustive enumeration) rather than data structures or amortized algorithms.
